storyline.label: Nemotron 3.5
storyline.latest_title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt

prior_narrative.tldr: vLLM announced day-0 support for NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on Oct 15, covering image, document and video input through OpenAI-compatible serving. Comparison write-ups against rival open models followed within a day.
prior_narrative.whats_new: OrcaRouter published head-to-head comparisons on Oct 16 pitting Nemotron 3.5 Super VL against Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp, framed around pricing and availability rather than raw scores.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Day-0 vLLM support means you can test Nemotron 3.5 Super VL on an existing OpenAI-compatible serving stack for document and video agents; the comparisons show the real decision is metered API versus self-hosted weights.

status.detail: Servable on vLLM from launch day; independent comparisons started appearing Oct 16.

beats.headline: vLLM ships day-0 support for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
beats.summary: Multimodal serving (image, document, video) with OpenAI-compatible endpoints and multi-token prediction.

beats.headline: OrcaRouter pits it against Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp
beats.summary: Three write-ups in one day, centered on metered pricing versus downloadable weights.

open_questions: Do independent benchmarks confirm the index-point gaps OrcaRouter reports against DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp?
Will other inference engines or clouds add Nemotron 3.5 Super VL beyond vLLM?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: If you run multimodal document or video agents, point an existing vLLM deployment at Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and rerun your own eval before trusting a single vendor-neutral comparison site.

day_captions.5b7496a31dc4a921: Launch-day serving path: vLLM supports the model with OpenAI-compatible endpoints for image, document and video input.
day_captions.fa7edf5313b75f42: Arabic-language edition of the OrcaRouter Kimi K3 comparison, framing download versus per-token pricing.
day_captions.6e859d00d3f1f59e: OrcaRouter compares it with DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp and reports an eight-index-point gap.
day_captions.1e11786f937b04c6: OrcaRouter contrasts a metered flagship with Kimi K3's weight release, which has no published rate card.
